settings.label: Empty Cart Headline
settings.default: Looks like your cart is empty

settings.label: Savings tag suffix
settings.info: Appended after "Saving X%" on non-subscription lines. Leave empty for just "Saving X%".

settings.label: Subscription savings suffix
settings.info: Appended after "Saving X%" on subscription lines, e.g. "w/ Autofill".

settings.label: Locked gift properties
settings.info: Comma-separated cart line property names that mark a locked free gift (e.g. _igGWP, _free_gift). A $0 line carrying any of these shows as FREE and is locked — no quantity, subscribe, or remove.

settings.label: Shipping Text
settings.default: Shipping, taxes, and discount codes calculated at checkout.

settings.label: Shipping row — not yet qualified
settings.info: Shown in the order summary Shipping row before the free-shipping threshold is met.

settings.label: Shipping row — free shipping earned
settings.info: Shown in the order summary Shipping row once the Intelligems free-shipping threshold is met.

settings.label: Show free shipping when a subscription is in the cart
settings.info: Relies on the store's "Free Shipping" automatic discount (applies on subscriptions, no minimum). Turn off if that discount is ever removed — or for markets whose rates exceed its cap.

settings.label: Klaviyo List ID
settings.info: Enter your Klaviyo List ID here.

settings.label: Newsletter Success Message
settings.info: Shown when a customer successfully signs up for the newsletter.

settings.label: Default CTA Text
settings.info: Shown for products that are not sold out, coming soon, or pre-order

settings.label: Sold Out CTA Text
settings.info: Shown for products that are sold out

settings.label: Sold Out Banner Text
settings.info: Shown at the top of product card for sold out products

settings.label: Coming Soon CTA Text
settings.info: Shown for products that are coming soon

settings.label: Coming Soon Banner Text
settings.info: Shown at the top of product card for coming soon products

settings.label: Pre-Order CTA Text
settings.info: Shown for products that are available for pre-order

settings.label: Pre-Order Banner Text
settings.info: Shown at the top of product card for pre-order products

settings.label: Bundle Banner Text
settings.info: Shown at the top of product card for product bundles

settings.content: Server-side passcode check (CTR Password Gate section set to "Server"). The layout only runs the check on the templates listed here; every other page is untouched.

settings.label: Template suffixes to check
settings.info: Comma separated, e.g. mini-deo-kit for product.mini-deo-kit. A gate on a template not listed here falls back to Browser mode.
